home.seo_desc: Building fast, secure, and user-friendly mobile and web applications.
home.hero_subtitle: We build Android apps and websites for everyday things — checking card balances, reading QRIS codes, finding a Quran verse from its recitation, tracing where a forwarded hadith comes from, following along at a tahlil. Built at home, used at home, passed on to whoever needs them.
home.hero_signature: do code for fun, no.. serious things.
home.origin_p1: A baskom is the enamel basin in every Indonesian kitchen — green marbled splash, white inside, dark blue rolled rim. Cheap, dented, immortal. Nobody treats a baskom as something precious, and that is exactly the point. Everything gets mixed in it: dough, rujak, laundry, coconut ice for the neighbourhood feast.
home.origin_p2: Ours just happens to be full of code. Ideas go in, get stirred, and come out as apps — built at home, used at home, passed on to whoever needs them. No ceremony.
home.dev_profile_desc: All BaskomLabs apps in one place.
home.qrstu_desc: Scan a QRIS code, unpack what is inside it, and learn how it works.
home.pembacakue_desc: Check eMoney, Flazz, and other NFC card balances straight from your phone.
home.yasintahlil_desc: Yasin, Tahlil, Maulid & Sholawat in full — works without an internet connection.
home.nfc_desc: We tinker with NFC to connect cards and phones safely — from reading an eMoney balance to understanding the conversation between a card and a reader. That is what PembacaKUE is made of.
home.contact_desc: Want to talk about a project, found a bug in one of our apps, or just curious about something? Say hello.
home.apps_title: Small apps and websites for everyday things.
home.qris_desc: One QR code carries a lot of data: merchant name, city, even the amount. QRSTU unpacks that structure so it is easy to read and learn from.
home.offline_desc: Yasin, Tahlil and Maulid readings are stored on the phone, so they still open at a gathering where the signal is bad.
home.suite_title: What we use ourselves at work.
home.suite_desc: Product Suite is an internal toolkit for testing payment flows from one place — from simulating transactions to checking integrations before a release. It was built for the team’s day-to-day work, not as a public app.
home.suite_note: Access is limited to team members. It is not available to download or sign up for.
home.ruang_label: FROM THE YASIN TAHLIL NU APP
home.ruang_desc: Readings on the virtues of Yasin and Tahlil, the Maulid books, NU tradition and Al-Hikam — the same Ruang Ilmu you find inside the app, readable right here. Content is in Indonesian.
home.qurandiscovery_desc: Find a Quran verse by listening to recitation. Read with translation and tafsir.
home.hadithdiscovery_desc: Got a hadith forwarded to you? Paste it to see which book and number it comes from, with its grading quoted from named scholars. Offline, no account.
home.oss_title: Code we build in the open.
home.oss_desc: Beyond mobile apps, we build and maintain open-source developer tools, protocol compliance engines, and local-first software — from QRIS parsing libraries to offline Markdown notebooks for Confluence.

opensource.hero_lead: Developer tools, protocol parsers, and local-first utilities built by Muh Akmal and BaskomLabs. Free, open, and crafted to solve real-world development friction.
opensource.creator_bio: Crafting payment protocol parsers, local-first documentation tooling, and privacy-respecting Android apps. Everything open-source is published directly on GitHub.
opensource.conote_desc: A fast, local-first PRD & Markdown notebook for Confluence Cloud. Lets product managers and engineers draft specs offline in plain Markdown with zero editor lag, an interactive space tree, and conflict-safe publishing.
opensource.project_conote_desc: A fast, local-first PRD & Markdown notebook for Confluence Cloud. Lets product managers and engineers draft specs offline in plain Markdown with zero editor lag, an interactive space tree, and conflict-safe publishing.
opensource.conote_f1: Local-first & offline editing with plain .md files
opensource.conote_f2: Dual writing mode: WYSIWYG for PMs, split Markdown preview for engineers
opensource.conote_f3: Interactive visual Confluence space tree navigation
opensource.conote_f4: Conflict-aware publishing with automated XHTML validation
opensource.qris_desc: Production-grade Python library, compliance auditor, dynamic generator, and CLI tool for Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS), built strictly to Bank Indonesia, ASPI v1.0, and EMVCo standards.
opensource.project_qris_desc: Production-grade Python library, compliance auditor, dynamic generator, and CLI tool for Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS), built strictly to Bank Indonesia, ASPI v1.0, and EMVCo standards.
opensource.qris_f1: Full recursive TLV (MPM) and Base64 BER-TLV (CPM CPV01) decoding
opensource.qris_f2: ISO/IEC 13239 CRC-16 engine with repair suggestions
opensource.qris_f3: ASPI compliance auditor (Static vs. Dynamic requirements, mandatory tags)
opensource.qris_f4: Static-to-Dynamic converter with nominal injection & 100+ bank/wallet NNS dictionary
opensource.blog_desc: Modern personal developer blog and technical writing platform built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Remark, documenting payment gateway mechanics, reverse engineering, and mobile architecture.
opensource.project_blog_desc: Modern personal developer blog and technical writing platform built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Remark, documenting payment gateway mechanics, reverse engineering, and mobile architecture.
opensource.blog_f2: Tailwind CSS v4 styling with light/dark theme support
opensource.blog_f3: Markdown & Remark pipeline with syntax highlighting
opensource.web_desc: The open-source repository powering this website, featuring zero-dependency prerendering for GitHub Pages, bilingual i18n, and interactive learning tracks on NFC, QRIS, and on-device ML.
opensource.project_web_desc: The open-source repository powering this website, featuring zero-dependency prerendering for GitHub Pages, bilingual i18n, and interactive learning tracks on NFC, QRIS, and on-device ML.
opensource.web_f1: Vite + React 19 single-page bundle with head-level prerender
opensource.web_f3: Fully responsive design with enamel brand tokens and dark mode
opensource.upcoming_desc: We are extracting the contactless NFC card reading engine from PembacaKUE into a standalone, reusable open-source library (kue-reader) to simplify reading Indonesian electronic money cards.
opensource.contribute_title: Got an edge case or idea?
opensource.contribute_desc: Every pull request, bug report, and architectural suggestion is welcome. Check out the source repositories on GitHub, inspect how the code works, and contribute.

footer.signature: do code for fun, no.. serious things.
